title: Pure Zenet
summary: The eleven Glorious Victors Zenet cards (TCG 3 December 2026) with three Normal Monsters and four non-Effect Fusion Monsters, built to play the page's combo lines. Every Zenet Ritual Monster can discard itself for value and then be Ritual Summoned straight from the GY, using Normal Monsters from the Deck as material.

summary.title: Starters
points: Zenet Revelator Nefertari: when it is summoned it sends itself to the GY, shows up to two Normal Monster Cards and Sets that many Zenet Spells from the Deck (Pere-Zenet Em Heru and Zenet Per Aarkh).

Zenet Per Aarkh: adds any Zenet monster from the Deck; later, from the GY, it turns a discarded Zenet Ritual Monster into a non-Effect Fusion Monster with equal or lower ATK, treated as a Normal Monster Card.
Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx: discards itself to add any other Zenet card from the Deck, then comes back from the GY through Em Heru.
Return Journey to the Light "Zenet": shows three Normal Monster Cards to Special Summon Nefertari or Amenhotep from the Deck, or two to summon a Level 8 or lower non-Effect Fusion Monster.

summary.title: Opening: Nefertari Alone
steps: Normal Summon Zenet Revelator Nefertari, send it to the GY and Set Pere-Zenet Em Heru and Zenet Per Aarkh.
Per Aarkh adds Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx; Sphinx discards itself for Return Journey, and Per Aarkh banishes itself from the GY for Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon. Em Heru draws a card.
Em Heru Ritual Summons Sphinx from the GY with Tri-Horned Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck, and equips one of them to it.
Return Journey Special Summons Zenet Revelator Amenhotep from the Deck, which Sets Zenet Cataract and Zenet Thunder Fall.

summary.title: Normal Monsters
summary.text: Em Heru and Amduat Zenet need Normal Monster Cards with different names whose Levels reach the Ritual Monster's: Tri-Horned Dragon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon (Level 8 each) cover Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx together and Tau-Zenet Adjat alone, and Labradorite Dragon (Level 6) covers Zenet-Mose Nekhbet. All three can be shown from the Deck for Nefertari, Amenhotep and Return Journey, so the deck runs only one of each.

summary.title: Extra Deck: non-Effect Fusions
points: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon (4500 ATK): Per Aarkh's pick when Sphinx is discarded.
Black Skull Dragon (3200 ATK): Per Aarkh's pick when Tau-Zenet Adjat is discarded; alone it puts your Normal Monster Cards over the 3000 ATK that Cataract's and Thunder Fall's GY effects need.
Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon (Level 7, 2800 ATK): Return Journey's two-card option, with no restriction on direct attacks; also Per Aarkh's pick for Zenet-Mose Nekhbet.
Sea Monster of Theseus (Level 5, 2200 ATK): the cheapest target for either card.

summary.title: Release
summary.text: Glorious Victors is out in the TCG on 3 December 2026, so until then the list checker reports the Zenet cards as not yet released.

allow.Blue-Eyes White Dragon: A Level 8 Normal Monster: Ritual material for Em Heru and Amduat Zenet, and a card to show for Nefertari, Amenhotep and Return Journey.
allow.Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon: A non-Effect Fusion Monster with 4500 ATK: Zenet Per Aarkh summons it, as a Normal Monster Card, when Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx is discarded.
allow.Black Skull Dragon: A non-Effect Fusion Monster with 3200 ATK, reprinted in Glorious Victors: Zenet Per Aarkh summons it when Tau-Zenet Adjat is discarded.
allow.Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon: A Level 7 non-Effect Fusion Monster, reprinted in Glorious Victors: Return Journey to the Light "Zenet" summons it with two Normal Monster Cards shown.

main: Zenet Revelator Nefertari
Sends itself to the GY on summon to Set two Zenet Spells; on their turn, banishes itself to equip a Normal Monster to a Ritual Monster.
Zenet Revelator Amenhotep
Sends itself to the GY on summon to Set two Zenet Traps; banishes itself to shuffle Normal Monsters from the GY into the Deck.
Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx
Level 12 Ritual: discards itself to search any Zenet card; flips their monsters face-down; unaffected by their activated effects while equipped.
Tau-Zenet Adjat
Level 8 Ritual: discards itself to send a Zenet card from the Deck to the GY; returns up to three of their cards to the hand.
Zenet-Mose Nekhbet
Level 6 Ritual: discards itself to add a Zenet card from the GY; turns an equipped Normal Monster back into a monster with 2500 more ATK.
Tri-Horned Dragon
Level 8 Normal Monster: Ritual material, a card to show, and the usual Equip Card.
Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Level 8 Normal Monster with a different name, so it pairs with Tri-Horned Dragon for Sphinx's Level 12.
Labradorite Dragon
Level 6 Normal Monster: covers Zenet-Mose Nekhbet on its own, and a third card to show.
Pere-Zenet Em Heru
Field Spell: once per turn, Ritual Summons a Zenet Ritual Monster from the hand or GY with Normal Monsters from the hand, Deck or field; draws when you Special Summon a Normal Monster.
Zenet Per Aarkh
Searches any Zenet monster; from the GY, turns a discarded Zenet Ritual Monster into a non-Effect Fusion Monster.
Return Journey to the Light "Zenet"
Shows Normal Monster Cards to summon Nefertari or Amenhotep from the Deck, or a Level 8 or lower non-Effect Fusion; draws if a shown card was in your hand.
Amduat Zenet
Normal Trap: Ritual Summons on your opponent's turn; from the GY, saves a Normal Monster Card from destruction.
Zenet Cataract
Normal Trap: negates the first monster effect from each chosen Main Monster Zone; from the GY, sends a monster to the GY.
Zenet Thunder Fall
Counter Trap: negates and destroys a Spell/Trap; from the GY, Sets another Zenet Spell/Trap.
extra: 4500 ATK: Per Aarkh's pick for a discarded Sphinx.
3200 ATK: Per Aarkh's pick for a discarded Adjat.
Level 7: Return Journey's two-card summon, free to attack directly.
Level 5, 2200 ATK: the lowest target for either card.
